paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Loss comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values for two models, Ex1 and Ex2, during a continual pretraining process. The x-axis represents the ‘Step’ value, displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick labels spaced every 10000 units. The y-axis represents ‘Loss’ on a logarithmic scale, extending from approximately 1.0 x 10<sup>-1</sup> to 1.2 x 10<sup>1</sup>. The blue solid line represents the loss value for Ex1, which begins at approximately 1.1 x 10<sup>-1</sup> at Step 0 and decreases to approximately 1.8 x 10<sup>-1</sup> at Step 60000. The purple dashed line represents the loss value for Ex2, starting at approximately 1.0 x 10<sup>-1</sup> at Step 0 and decreasing to approximately 2.0 x 10<sup>-1</sup> at Step 60000. The green dotted line represents the validation loss for Ex2, which begins at approximately 1.1 x 10<sup>-1</sup> at Step 0 and decreases to approximately 1.9 x 10<sup>-1</sup> at Step 60000.
